title: Cell Science (AICS) Gap Analysis
detailed_heading: Detailed Dataset Analysis: AICS Primary-Image Metadata (Cell lines, Cell Science)
intro: This section provides a field-level breakdown for the Allen Institute for Cell Science (AICS) primary-image metadata dataset. The source is a discovery-oriented Parquet view — one row per retained primary-image file, 186 top-level fields and four nested objects containing 49 physical child fields — drawn from a 33,184-row REMBI-categorized slim view of AICS candidate schema 0.6.0.

The central structural difference is the unit of registration: one AICS row is one image file, while one aind data asset represents an acquisition-level collection produced by a single acquisition. Mapping each file row to a separate asset would duplicate acquisition, instrument, specimen and processing metadata and could invent artificial sessions. Compounding this, AICS is cell-line-centric — cell line, parental line, clone, tagged structure and culture state are the primary biological identity — whereas aind Subject detail types describe live animals and humans, so acquisition.subject_id and specimen_id cannot be populated without a governed cell-line profile.

intro.label: Classification note.
intro.body: The standalone AICS analysis classified 186 fields on a six-way scale (Direct / Partial / Extension container / No first-class analog / Platform or manifest / Derived-search-only) suited to a quantitative crosswalk. For continuity with the rest of this report, the tables below are re-expressed on the five-way scheme: Direct becomes Mapped, a semantic or cardinality mismatch becomes Conflict, an ambiguous destination becomes Needs Review, an extension-container-only or absent construct becomes Gap, and platform/manifest or search-only fields become Unmappable. Per the house interpretive principle, a field retained only in a flexible parameters or notes dictionary is an extension container, not a true semantic match, and is classified Gap. The full six-way crosswalk and all 186 fields remain in the companion workbook, AICS_AIND_Data_Schema_Field_Crosswalk.xlsx.

sample_asset: One row per retained primary-image file; 186 top-level fields; four nested objects (49 physical child fields)
Mapping evidence: 11 Direct, 75 Partial, 48 extension-container, 23 no first-class analog, 10 platform/manifest, 19 derived/search-only
Modality: in-vitro light microscopy of tagged human iPSC-derived cell lines
Storage: AWS / Vast — per-file paths; an asset root must be derived by a governed aggregation rule
Scope boundary: the slim primary-image view, not the full 282-field governed AICS class model; conclusions apply to onboarding this view

gap_summary.gap: Asset boundary: one AICS row is one image file; one aind asset is an acquisition-level collection
gap_summary.detail: Identity, location and every repeated field depend on the aggregation rule. Aggregating file rows into an acquisition asset requires a deterministic key led by acquisition_group_id, timing, instrument and biological context, plus a companion file manifest. Do not create one acquisition per file by default.

gap_summary.gap: Biological identity: cell lines and clones have no first-class Subject analog
gap_summary.detail: AICS models cell lines, clones and lineage; aind v2.9.0 models animal/human Subjects and derived specimen IDs. Required subject_id/specimen_id cannot be populated without a governed cell-line/specimen profile. Treating a cell-line identifier as subject_id would be syntactically convenient but semantically misleading.

gap_summary.gap: Acquisition timing is required and timezone-aware; AICS dates are heterogeneous and often date-only
gap_summary.detail: Acquisition and DataStream objects may fail validation or misstate events. Migration must parse values into number-plus-unit and timezone-aware datetimes, retain raw text for provenance, and reject fabricated timezone or end-time values.

gap_summary.gap: Instrument/config referential integrity requires named devices and a coordinate system
gap_summary.detail: A complete Instrument plus DataStream needs named cameras, detectors, lasers, triggers and a coordinate system. Objective facts alone (magnification, exposure) cannot construct them; DataStream.active_devices requires names matching Instrument components that the view does not supply.

gap_summary.gap: Plate, well, layout, colony and experimental-condition metadata have no first-class model
gap_summary.detail: Core experimental design would become untyped protocol_parameters or be lost. A typed plate/well/layout profile is needed and referenced from the acquisition/specimen package. Same absence SeaHub raised for its three-level combinatorial index hierarchy.

gap_summary.gap: Generic image-file metadata exceeds aind's acquisition-level image model
gap_summary.detail: Physical format, TCZYX shape, axis order, byte size and previews have no generic aind core field. A governed file-and-image manifest or an imaging extension is needed beneath the acquisition asset; storage/cache lifecycle fields belong in the registry platform, not portable scientific JSON.

gap_summary.gap: Culture, preparation, treatments, concentrations and timepoints exceed Reagent and SpecimenProcedure vocabularies
gap_summary.detail: aind Reagent lacks role, concentration, volume, group and treatment timing. Flexible parameters preserve values but not interoperable semantics; seeding, replate, differentiation, fixation, media, passage and treatment events should be normalized into ordered SpecimenProcedure or Manipulation records with typed profile fields.

gap_summary.gap: Processing fields lack the code URLs, experimenters, timestamps, ordering and dependency graph for reproducible DataProcess records
gap_summary.detail: Derived-data provenance is only partly constructible. Flat analysis/segmentation/output fields must expand into ordered DataProcess records with process type, stage, Code URL/version/commit, parameters, experimenters, timestamps, inputs, outputs and a dependency graph.

gap_summary.gap: AICS QC flags can become QCMetric records, but require normalization
gap_summary.detail: Modality, evaluation stage, typed metric value, grouping tags and status history must be defined for AICS QC flags. Registry workflow state must be kept separate from scientific QC status; a default_grouping policy must be defined for generated metrics.

gap_summary.gap: Required administrative metadata is absent or ambiguous
gap_summary.detail: Institution, funding source, investigator identity and creation semantics are not present in the supplied view, so DataDescription cannot be validated from it alone. These must be supplied from authoritative dataset-level sources, with v2.9.0 pinned for the migration.

post_gap_notes.label: Required-field readiness.
post_gap_notes.body: Forty-two high-value aind required or conditionally-required checks were evaluated for the in-vitro imaging pathway: twenty-eight are high-severity gaps, nine medium, and five low-severity or directly available. This is a readiness assessment of the information needed to construct valid, scientifically meaningful aind objects, not a population percentage. Metadata and Instrument are Partial; DataDescription and Subject/specimen are Low; Procedures, Acquisition/DataStream, Processing and QualityControl are Partial. Principal blockers include data_description.institution, funding_source, acquisition.subject_id/specimen_id, Channel.detector device identity and trigger, instrument.global_coordinate_system, and DataProcess.code.url.
